checks: The isolated verifier passes source/tool/dependency pins, complete 96-byte body and 39-instruction geometry, three full-image direct callers, and all nine static MMIO/input traces.

Instruction-by-instruction review confirms raw count and shifted count writes, end-pointer order, bit-1 ready gate at +0x28, byte load with post-increment, zero-extended word write to +0x60, full completion-word zero polling, B4C before/after waits, and return zero.

Caller paths prove CEC and D38 pass zero pointer/count on the fallthrough reaching these calls. D42 supplies SP+4 and count 2. All return values are ignored. The MMIO clear address computes as A2000080+74=A20000F4.
limitations: Trace cases are controlled/static rather than live C-SKY routine execution. B4C has its own scoped review 1495; controller identity/timing and physical effects are not established. Wait loops are unbounded. Mapping remains conditional and no canonical admission is made.
